features.name: Project scaffold & verification
features.description: Rust WASM crate + React/Vite frontend build from a clean checkout; `./init.sh` runs cargo test and the web lint/typecheck/build gates
features.evidence: cargo test 5/5 pass; pnpm -C web run lint/typecheck/build pass; wasm asset bundled

features.name: Thread dump parsing (multi-format)
features.description: Parse jstack output and ThreadMXBean#dumpAllThreads (ThreadInfo#toString) format: detect format, split threads, extract name/id/state/held-locks/waiting-lock

features.name: Problem-pattern analysis
features.description: Thread-state grouping counts and lock-blocking detection (blocked thread -> lock -> owning thread edges)

features.name: In-browser result rendering
features.description: Local file selection, call WASM analyzeDump, render summary, state bar chart, lock-contention table and thread table
features.evidence: web/src/App.tsx + analyzer.ts; manual test: Load sample renders 3 threads, main BLOCKED on lock held by worker

features.name: Format & UX hardening
features.description: Drag-and-drop upload, deadlock cycle detection, larger real-world dump coverage
features.evidence: web/src/App.tsx drag-and-drop (onDrop/onDragOver) + deadlock panel; src/parser.rs detect_deadlocks (functional wait-for graph) + is_thread_header robustness; tests detects_two_thread_deadlock, no_false_deadlock_on_simple_contention, parses_real_world_deadlock_dump (tests/fixtures/deadlock_real_jstack.txt from javac 21)

features.name: Export HTML / PDF
features.description: Export a self-contained HTML report(same css/js as web app) and a PDF (via pdf-lib, in one page)
features.evidence: web/src/export.ts: HTML report embeds the app's own index.css via ?inline and reuses result markup/classes (incl. deadlocks); PDF rendered with pdf-lib on a single A4 page (proportional state bars, deadlocks, contention, threads)

features.name: java code generation
features.description: generate java code, form lock contention/waiting threads, and deadlock cycle
features.evidence: src/codegen.rs + src/tests/java_code_generation.rs (5 tests); wasm binding generateJava; examples/gen_java.rs; validated with javac 21: generated DeadlockCycle.java compiled and ran, JVM reported 'Found one Java-level deadlock' (deadlock-0->1->2); web UI 'Generate Java reproducer' panel

features.name: java version support
features.description: 调研不同版本java的jstack/ThreadMXBean输出格式差异，通过jenv安装8/11/17/21，分别运行样例代码，用jstack/ThreadMXBean#dumpAllThreads，解析结果并对比

features.name: ThreadMXBean format lock contentions bug fix
features.description: Fix the bug in the ThreadMXBean format lock contentions detection

features.name: Deadlock cycle detection
features.description: Detect and visualize deadlock cycles in the thread state graph
features.evidence: Implemented with feat-005: src/parser.rs detect_deadlocks + Analysis.deadlocks; visualized in web/src/App.tsx deadlock panel and included in HTML/PDF exports
